title: Fubini identity for mixed points on the cube Q_δ (the Fubini step of parent step 3)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, δ ∈ ℝ, k ∈ Fin (m + 1), Q_δ := {y ∈ Euclid (m + 1) : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}, and let h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ be integrable on Q_δ. For x, y let a_k(x, y) be the point whose j-th coordinate is y_j for j < k and x_j for j ≥ k. Then ∫_{Q_δ} ∫_{Q_δ} h(a_k(x, y)) dy dx = volume(Q_δ)·∫_{Q_δ} h.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (k : Fin (m + 1)) (h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn h {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ} → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, h (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j < k then y j else x j)) = (volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}).toReal * ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, h x
